title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.54
subtitle: Wetness ends where the water ends.

highlights.title: Water line on the liquid surface
highlights.description: TETHYS Wetness reads the liquid surface of your FLIP cache, so the water line on clothing sits exactly at the water instead of a few centimetres above it.

highlights.title: Rebake once
highlights.description: Wetness bakes from an earlier version are baked again the next time, with the corrected water line.

highlights.title: PATTERN NeXt workspace
highlights.description: Draw patterns in a locked 2D editor next to your 3D view. Polygon, Rectangle, Ellipse and Curve tools, point and curve editing, snapping and measurements.
